title: Release quest-cli 0.8.0: version bump, CI-built platform binaries, qualification, tag
description: 29 commits sit on dev unpublished since the 0.7.1 hotfix freeze (2026-09-15), including QCLI-297's breaking removal-fails-loud change plus several Added/Fixed entries. The gap has cost the fleet three independent orchestrator-session investigations of the same already-fixed bug (--remove-note silent no-op) because every fresh session installs the published npm binary. QCLI-328 establishes that a Changed (breaking) CHANGELOG entry should correspond to at least a minor bump, so this releases as 0.8.0, not 0.7.2. Follow docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md: strings-then-bytes version bump (two commits), CI-built platform binaries via prepublication-qualification.yml dispatch, full qualification record, changelog finalization at tag time, native-execution receipt. Stops at 'ready to publish' -- the actual npm publish needs separate explicit owner authorization per that runbook's Prerequisites and is not covered by this task.

implementationNotes: PR #182 (strings + CI-built bytes) merged to dev at 9fdfbdc, all three required contexts green. PR #183 (QCLI-333, a Tracker-integrity CI defect discovered mid-release) merged first at f9e8d79 -- it was blocking: the version-check step matched the first 'Quest CLI <version>' anywhere in CLAUDE.md rather than the managed block, so this repo's own historical narrative mention of 0.7.1 was winning over the correct 0.8.0 declaration. dev is now at 9fdfbdc with package.json 0.8.0 and all six platform binaries built by CI run 35282313234 (never locally rebuilt, so no darwin-arm64 SIGKILL-hazard risk survives into dev). Remaining per docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md: Step 4's full qualification record (only bun run check + check:packages + test:packages have run so far -- black-box, fault, clone/worktree, migration, scale, provenance, dependency-license and repository-identity checks are NOT yet separately attached as evidence); Step 5 changelog finalization (rename Unreleased -> ## 0.8.0, add fresh Unreleased) and tagging; native-execution receipt. Step 7 (actual npm publish) requires the user's own direct authorization per the runbook's Prerequisites and Tier-3 in opum-fleet-operating.md -- do not proceed to it on any relayed approval.
